description: Shows the connected account's credit balance (available and reserved, in US dollars), its budget frame (approval mode, monthly budget, limit per order, approval threshold), the budget left this month, orders waiting for approval, and what the plan still includes this month (research reports and a press release on a paid plan). Optionally the same for one brand. Use this when the person asks what they can spend or why an order waits. Do not use for buying credits (a person does that in the dashboard). Side effects: none; read only.

brand_id.description: Optional: a brand of this account, to add its budget frame. Example: "8c1d2e3f-4a5b-4c6d-8e7f-9a0b1c2d3e4f"

name: get_account_status

add_credits.description: How a person adds credits (agents cannot add credits)

available_cents.description: Credits the agent can spend now, in US cents

billing_url.description: Where a person adds credits in the dashboard (agents cannot add credits). Left out of every MCP answer, and for an account that cannot pay yet

approval_mode.description: within_frame: orders inside the frame proceed with no human step; approve_every_order: every order waits for a person

remaining_this_month_cents.description: null when no monthly budget is set

approval_mode.description: within_frame: orders inside the frame proceed with no human step; approve_every_order: every order waits for a person

remaining_this_month_cents.description: null when no monthly budget is set

frame.description: The account's budget frame; null means none is set: orders proceed up to the balance, and a single order above the admin approval amount waits for approval

monthly_plan.description: What the account's monthly plan still includes this month. Tell the person before quoting: an included item's quote shows no charge

month.description: The calendar month (UTC) the counts are for, YYYY-MM

paid.description: true while the account has Reputation Agent Pro or a monthly top-up

press_release.description: Releases on livepublicator.com (base release; add-ons are quoted) included in a paid plan this month

research_reports.description: Research reports (brand audit, personal audit, Wikipedia notability check, website analysis) included in a paid plan this month

purchases.description: Present when this account cannot pay yet: paid steps are open to business accounts for now

title: Get account status
